scope: Local Member matching evidence mapping only. No identity, ISRC-format, eligible-account or match validation; no provider form, automatic matching, submission, acceptance or receipt. This does not implement the Songwriter profile.

work in eligible catalog.next_step: Map evidence of the exact work in the eligible catalog. Inspect the actual Member Hub/account capability before any operation; a supplied role is not verified eligibility.

recording group/ISRC.next_step: Map the selected recording group and its underlying recordings/ISRC evidence. Preserve group scope and original identifiers; the helper does not validate or normalize ISRCs.

identity evidence.next_step: Compare the work and recording evidence across writers, recording artist, version and identifiers. Inspect group details; title similarity alone cannot establish identity.
identity evidence.basis: The MLC recommends considering all result data; writer/version comparison also preserves the existing local profile preflight.

member_match_review.hub_eligibility: Verify the actual Member Hub capability and work in eligible catalog. The existing profile accepts only the supplied member_rightsholder role; account access and eligibility remain unknown.
member_match_review.identity_comparison: Compare writers, version, recording artist and identifiers for the exact work and recording group. Do not infer a match from title alone; source meaning is not checked by this helper.
member_match_review.group_coverage: Review all recordings in each selected group and preserve the original group/work scope. A complete evidence mapping does not certify a group or apply a suggested match.
member_match_review.match_history: Retain observed per-group submitted, in-progress, accepted, partially accepted, rejected or rematched status separately. Rematching may move recordings into another group; do not collapse partial/rematched results into acceptance.
member_match_review.authority: Verify applicable mandate, rights, territory, dates and original disclosure before any separately authorized action. Preparation establishes neither collection entitlement nor provider authority.

review_basis: Public MLC instructions describe matching and Match History. Exact evidence binding, authority and writer/version review preserve local catalog safeguards; these are not provider schema fields.
remaining_account_checks: Inspect the actual account capability, selected work and recording groups before any separately authorized suggestion.
Only actual provider responses and readback establish match status; preparation records no receipt or financial result.
